summary: Tested 11 new mobile screens under 'Their Care' and 'Journeys & Paperwork' on Expo web preview at 390x844. Logged in as cathy@example.com. All screens render with proper testIDs and load real backend data: care-team shows Antony/Care Manager with Call/Email/Remove; key-contacts empty state with 'Add a contact' CTA; calendar groups visits by day with DISPUTED badges; hospital shows 4 admissions with IN HOSPITAL/DISCHARGED badges, Log button opens form; care-plans shows empty state + AI review CTA (expected for this account); timeline lists 13+ decoded/invoice events with tappable statement/invoice links; journeys shows '2 of 5 done' progress bar with completed persona/csc; documents lists real docs with Download; correspondence lists real letters; ratings shows BlueBerry Care 4-star with Compare Providers CTA and add form opens; compare-providers ranks BlueBerry #1 with trophy. Dark theme (via settings testID 'theme-dark') applied globally - all screens render high-contrast text on dark background legibly. Login flow works fine.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings emitted from lib components. Not blocking but should migrate for React Native Web parity. Reference: various UI components using shadowColor/shadowOffset.
'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' warning triggered when opening hospital form / ratings form. Likely from an older RN component in the tree. Non-blocking.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning on login screen. Non-blocking migration item.

action_items: (Optional/low) Migrate remaining shadow* usages to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional/low) Replace any TouchableMixin/TouchableWithoutFeedback usages with Pressable to silence deprecation warning.
(Optional/low) Update login screen input to use style.pointerEvents instead of props.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactsView.tsx: chip role selector uses <T> (Text) with onPress rather than Pressable — works but a Pressable with an inner Text would be more idiomatic and better accessibility.

timeline.tsx: Card testID is set to undefined for tappable events (line 106) — line is a no-op; tap handler works via onPress on the Text, but wrapping the whole Card as Pressable would enlarge the touch target.
hospital.tsx date field is a free-text 'YYYY-MM-DD' input — could use a date picker for better mobile UX.
documents.tsx: no dl_error clearing on new download attempt is fine since setDlError('') runs at start of download() — good.
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded caregiver cathy@example.com; existing admissions, calendar entries, timeline events, documents, correspondence, and ratings were sufficient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 new mobile routes (care-team, key-contacts, calendar, hospital, care-plans, timeline, journeys, documents, correspondence, ratings, compare-providers) rendered with real data on Expo web preview. testIDs present on every card, add button, action button, and empty state. Dark theme toggle in Settings ('theme-dark') applies globally and screens remain legible. Only deprecation warnings emitted (shadow*, TouchableMixin, props.pointerEvents) — non-blocking. No red screens, no 500s.
